scoring_justification: Compute-driven task with random N positions; structural trends (f_Gamma monotonicity, localisation peak in BAC gap, projected DOS splitting, host-DOS dip near EN) robustly verify BAC model reproduction.

outputs.description: Eigenstate properties: energy, fractional Γ character and localisation factor for each supercell eigenstate. Used to verify BAC model trends.
Projected DOS onto six representative host k-states. Energy grid 0–0.5 eV, step 1 meV. Used to verify BAC-splitting behavior.
Total DOS projected onto the host GaAs conduction-band states. Used to verify the overall DOS shape near the N resonant energy.

output_contract.notes: All scored artifacts are evaluated by structural audit (T3) against digitized reference curves from the paper's figures. The agent must implement the model Hamiltonian and compute observables; exact numerical agreement is not required due to randomness in N positions.

steps.description: Validate fractional Gamma character ordering (low energy > near EN and high energy > near EN) and localisation factor peak in the BAC gap (0.18-0.28 eV > low and high).
Validate projected DOS splitting pattern: fraction of mass around EM is low for k-states near EN and high for k-states far from EN.
Validate host-projected DOS dip near N resonant energy (minimum in 0.2-0.25 eV is lower than neighbouring bands).
